excerpts.author: jsign
excerpts.content:
Sharing some async updates here:
- A new version of `execution-spec-tests` for Verkle tests has been tagged: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/verkle%40v0.0.4 These were filled with a geth version that will be used for devnet7. (h/t to <@755913785620824175>  helping on the testing library front)
- While doing ^, we discovered (and fixed) some bugs in Geth and Nethermind (h/t <@822845173016166410>  for double checking filled tests before the tag, which is how we found bugs in both clients).
- AFAIK, at least two other EL clients are working on running those tests as a reparation for devnet7-readiness.
- I created EIP-7709 tests, some extra system contract tests, and I’m close to finish ~30 tests vectors reg insufficient gas border cases that are much more interesting... all which will be part of a v0.0.5 release (maybe in next week).
- There were fixes in CL clients during preparations for devnet7 launch.
